run_gradient_saliency: run the gradient function to compute a saliency map for a PyTorch model input
create_saliency_map: create a saliency map by calling gradient with a model, input tensor, and target class
test_gradient_function: test the gradient function by passing a model and verifying it returns a saliency tensor
review_gradient_implementation: review the gradient function which delegates to saliency with context_builder set to None
summarize_gradient_module: summarize the gradient module that implements the GRAD method for deep network visualization
